extensionDescription.message: Send downloads, media and links straight to the Osprey download manager.

commandSendPageUrl.message: Send the current page's URL to Osprey

addLinkPlaceholder.message: Paste a link and press Return

emptyBody.message: Paste a link above, or just click a download link — Osprey will pick it up.

noLinksFound.message: No links found on this page.

noLikelyLinksBody.message: Turn off “Likely downloads” to see every link.

toastInvalidLink.message: That doesn’t look like a download link.

toastNotRunning.message: Osprey isn’t running — start it and try again.

toastUnauthorized.message: Osprey refused this browser. Pair it again in Settings.

offlineNotRunningBody.message: Start Osprey to send downloads to it and follow their progress here.

offlineNoHostBody.message: The browser helper isn’t set up yet. In Osprey, open Settings → Browser and choose Install, then try again.

offlineRemoteBody.message: Make sure it’s switched on and reachable, and that the address in Connection settings is right.

offlineRefusedBody.message: The device token may have been revoked. Pair this browser again in Connection settings.

pageKeptBody.message: Osprey isn’t running, so this download stayed in the browser.

pageFailedBody.message: The browser’s copy was already stopped. Download it in the browser instead?

pageAlwaysQuestion.message: Always let the browser handle downloads from $ARG1$?

pageAlwaysDone.message: Osprey will leave $ARG1$ to your browser. Change this in Osprey’s Sites settings.

pageMediaProtected.message: This player streams protected media, which Osprey can’t save.

pageMediaFoot.message: Downloads start in Osprey right away.

sectionCaptureSub.message: Which browser downloads Osprey takes over.

captureDownloadsHint.message: Send matching downloads to Osprey instead of the browser’s own download list.

settingShowConfirmationHint.message: Show a small note on the page when a download is sent, with a one-click way to keep it in the browser.

settingMinSizeHint.message: Smaller files stay in the browser. Use 0 to capture every size.

settingExtensionsHint.message: Only downloads ending in one of these are captured.

noFileTypes.message: No file types — nothing will be captured.

sectionSitesSub.message: Where Osprey should leave downloads to the browser.

settingExcludedDomainsHint.message: Includes subdomains: example.com also covers dl.example.com.

settingAlwaysBrowserHint.message: Sites you picked “Always use the browser” for on a download prompt. Remove one to capture from it again.

urlPatternHintLong.message: Matched against the whole download URL. Use * as a wildcard.

sectionMediaSub.message: Finding video, audio and streams on the pages you visit.

settingDetectMediaHint.message: Notice videos, audio and streams as pages load, so the popup can list them.

settingMediaButton.message: Show a download button on players

settingMediaButtonHint.message: A small Osprey button appears when you point at a video or audio player.

mediaProtectedNote.message: Streams protected by DRM, and players that stream from temporary blob: addresses, are listed but can’t be downloaded.

sectionNotificationsSub.message: System notifications while the popup is closed.

connectToHint.message: Osprey usually runs on this computer. Pick “Another computer” to send downloads to a paired Osprey elsewhere.

connectedNativeSub.message: Through the browser helper on this computer

notRunningSub.message: The browser helper is installed. Start Osprey to connect.

noHostSub.message: The browser helper isn’t installed for this browser yet.

refusedSub.message: The device token was rejected. Pair again below.

groupSetUpDesc.message: The extension talks to Osprey through a small helper that the app installs. No address or password needed.

stepInstallHelper.message: In Osprey, open Settings → Browser and choose Install for this browser.

stepTest.message: Come back here and choose Test connection.

launchRowHint.message: Starts the app on this computer (macOS).

remoteAddressHint.message: Shown in Osprey on that computer under Settings → Remote.

pairingCodeHint.message: In Osprey there, choose Pair a device. Codes work once, for two minutes.

pairedHint.message: A device token for this browser is saved. Forget it to unpair.

remotePrivacyNote.message: Captured downloads — including the cookies needed to fetch them — are sent to that computer over HTTPS.

errRemoteUrl.message: Enter an https:// address, like https://192.168.1.20:41780.

errPairingCode.message: Pairing codes have 8 letters and numbers, like ABCD-EFGH.

errToken.message: That doesn’t look like a device token.

errPairingRefused.message: That code didn’t work — codes expire after two minutes. Create a new one and try again.

errRateLimited.message: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.

errUnreachable.message: Couldn’t reach that address. If Osprey uses its own certificate, open the address in a tab once and accept it.

sectionShortcutsSub.message: Keyboard shortcuts for sending pages and moving around.

shortcutChangeHint.message: Pick your own keys in the browser’s shortcut settings.

shortcutFirefoxHint.message: In Firefox: Add-ons and themes → ⚙ → Manage Extension Shortcuts.

shortcutPopupSpace.message: Toggle a switch or a selected link

shortcutPageEsc.message: Dismiss an Osprey prompt or media panel

shortcutPageTab.message: Reach the media button of a focused player

sectionAboutSub.message: Version, privacy and where things live.

privacyLocal.message: Downloads, cookies and page details go only to Osprey — on this computer, or the one you paired.

privacyNoTracking.message: No analytics, tracking or remote code.

privacyStorage.message: Settings are kept in this browser’s extension storage, out of reach of web pages.
